newsitem.title: USA: United Cos secures $800 mln credit facility.
newsitem.headline: United Cos secures $800 mln credit facility.

text.p: United Cos Financial Corp on Friday said it secured a $800 million revolving credit facility.

The company plans to use proceeds from the three-year, senior unsecured credit facility to refinance existing debt and for general corporate purposes, including warehouse financing. United Cos provides non-traditional consumer and mortgage loan products.
The credit facility involved 22 participating lenders, with First Union National Bank acting as administrative agent and Morgan Guaranty Trust Co of New York as documentation agent.
In addition, Bank of America, Bank of New York and Fleet Bank acted as managing agents.
